gateSummary.rationale: V2 reconstructs the independently audited causal chain, including the Kimi README command, complete Claude success UI, detailed specification, pre-existing project-state boundary, external image-generation and human file handoff, local index.html SPA boundary, human review/revision ownership, 32/32 cue ledger, and bounded audio uncertainty. Residual evidence-reference defects remain below all hard thresholds and do not leave an unguarded carrier, meaning change, or relationship.

examples.note: Core promise retained as an author claim with timing/code/template qualifications.
Claude Code, Moonshot/Kimi K2, and alternative Kimi CLI roles are distinguished.
Exact Claude Code npm command retained.
Exact uv/Python/package Kimi CLI command retained and correctly described as README text, not demonstrated execution.
Endpoint, token boundary, five model variables, zshrc operation, and launch sequence retained.
All five success signals are stated: version, model, billing label, English exchange, Chinese exchange.
Technical stack, SPA architecture, engine/state/storage, character, UI, and file requirements are reconstructed.
Populated story/characters/assets and empty gameplay/image_pipeline are separated from unknown creation provenance.
Project premise, cast, values, schedule/action direction, and implementation boundary are retained.
External UI, four-variant groups, human selection/save/naming/placement, and Finder assets form a bounded chain.
Folder-to-agent integration and local index.html browser-SPA delivery boundary are explicit.
Shown preview states are separated from unoperated game systems.
Human planning, art/file operations, editorial review, and revision ownership remain visible.
Layout before/request/edit/after chain is reconstructed with CSS parameters and continuity caveat.
Writing quality remains a subjective author assessment without independent validation.

V2 omits the exact general theme-configuration field inventory (title/background/conflict/goal/3-5 NPC), the agent's emotional-resonance/network/workplace-realism planning suggestions, and the exact first-preview values Day 1/morning, energy 60, mood 40, money 3000, pressure 50. Their surrounding closures remain covered.

Evidence-v2 independently confirms an AAC audio stream, but the permitted ground truth does not contain the claimed -45 dB/250 ms silence-detection result or persistent-energy measurement. The candidate correctly abstains from naming music/SFX, so the unsupported detail does not contaminate the content reconstruction.

processDependencyCompleteness.rationale: Counted input, action, parameter, output, before, during, and after for each of the audit's ten stages. Partial fields do not count. V2 closes every demonstrated stage; losses are limited to the partly inferred pre-environment stage, API-key example parameters, and visible external-generation option parameters.

Claude install and Kimi CLI alternative are accurately bounded as shown instructions.
API-key creation is closed, but example name claudecode and project default are omitted.

Detailed specification, already-populated project, agent read/plan boundary, and unknown origin are all present.

File handoff, agent integration, and local index.html browser output are closed.

Human request, file/CSS edit, and revised preview form a complete state transition.
Genre examples, unverified generalization, and CTA are correctly bounded.

judgeDisposition.reason: All hard gates pass; JUDGE scores are therefore substantive and do not override any failed contract.

metaAudit.rationale: Independent comparison against the audit finds coverage of speech/platform subtitles, step overlays, README/config/spec/project text, API/terminal/Claude UI, external image UI, Finder files, browser preview, action sequences, examples, editing order, presenter framing, CTA, and the available AAC carrier. All seven audit meaning reversals are represented: showcase-to-tutorial, zero-code-to-technical-operations, plain-language-to-detailed-specification, blank-generation-to-pre-existing-project, agent-art-to-external/human-art, one-pass-to-human-review, and mobile-game-to-local-SPA. The audited graph is closed across human, Claude Code, Moonshot/K2, specification, existing project, external image tool, local files, browser prototype, review, and revision; hard cuts remain explicitly unclosed rather than falsely proved. The 32-cue transcript and cue ledger are independently exact and complete. Residual OCR-reference mistakes are evidence hygiene defects, not unguarded closures.

examples.detail: Evidence-v2 has 32 cues. reconstruction.transcript has the same 32 IDs, exact text, and exact start/end values; coverageMatrix.cueAccountability has 32 unique entries and every entry maps to at least one knowledge unit.
KU-13 through KU-17 preserve the missing-art problem, unbranded external UI, human selection/save/naming/placement, Finder state, agent discovery/integration, and local index.html browser output.
KU-09 through KU-12 recover the visible engineering/system requirements while explicitly refusing to assign creation provenance to the already-populated story/characters/assets state.

KU-20 cites OCR-00212 as the revision instruction, but that line actually reads '- 构建角色系统？'; other OCR ranges cross crop boundaries. The surrounding claim remains independently supported by cues, targeted frames, and later correct crop lines.
